reason: A source-code line bun prints under an error; the error's headline line is classified on its own.

match: ^\s*(severity|severity_local|code|detail|hint|where|file|line|routine|position|schema_name|table_name|column_name|constraint_name|errno)\s*:
reason: A field of a printed PostgresError object; the PostgresError line itself is classified on its own.

match: ^\[(analytics|research|swarm)-<n>\] (loop|scheduler|reaper) error: <n> \|
reason: The worker loop's headline for a caught error; the cause (PostgresError, connection error) follows on its own line and is classified there.

match: ^api error: <n> \|
reason: The api's headline for a caught error; the PostgresError line that follows is classified on its own.

match: is immutable: (DELETE|UPDATE) is not permitted on
reason: The boot's ledger guard probes each immutable table and REQUIRES this refusal; a missing refusal is what fails the boot.

match: is append-only: row deletion is not permitted|refused by trigger \w+_append_only
reason: The boot's append-only guard probes each protected table and REQUIRES this refusal from rm_append_only_guard().

match: CONTEXT: PL/pgSQL function public\.rm_\w+\(\) line|STATEMENT: DELETE FROM public\.\w+ WHERE false
reason: Postgres context lines for the guard probes' own DELETE ... WHERE false statements.

match: \bOK\b.*(guard armed|delete refused on every protected table|no calendar-invalid)|\b0 failed\b
reason: Success lines of the boot's own checks that happen to contain 'refused' or 'failed'.

match: robotmoney\.invalid
reason: The member-agent image build echoes its git config line, which uses the reserved .invalid mail domain.

match: v<n>-seed:bootstrap .* drift
reason: On an adopted (restored) database the seed reports drift as a warning and existing rows win, by design.

match: fetch returned <n> rows — using persisted <n> rows
reason: A live source returned nothing and the code used the real persisted floor, never synthetic data; the failed fetch itself is classified separately.

match: EDGAR MNA refresh: status=updated|\[edgar\] MNA refresh .*status=updated
reason: A successful EDGAR refresh summary; it contains the counter name 'rejected='.

match: reaper requeued/killed <n> stuck job\(s\)
reason: The worker reaper recovering jobs whose lease lapsed; the failure that caused the lapse is logged and classified on its own.

match: an upstream response is buffered to a temporary file
reason: nginx spilling a large response to disk; informational.

match: this-path-cannot-exist
reason: The live onboarding-skill test's own negative probe for a path that must 404.

match: geckoterminal.*(throttled|retry budget exhausted|HTTP <n> — retrying|HTTP 429)
reason: GeckoTerminal rate limiting; the code retries, then degrades to last-persisted data.

match: \[extract\] fetch \S+ \((yahoo|blockchain_com|fred|defillama\w*|geckoterminal\w*|coinmetrics)\) FAILED: The operation timed out
reason: A market-data provider timing out; the extractor falls back to the persisted real floor.

match: \[analytics-producer\] regime failed: The operation timed out
reason: The producer's regime run hit its shared fetch deadline while every provider fetch was still outstanding (production 2026-09-25 18:35:17: every source timed out in the same millisecond); no vintage is written for that slot, nothing synthetic, and the next scheduled run retries.

match: Base RPC HTTP|buyback-logs: live index failed
reason: The Base chain RPC endpoint failing; buyback indexing keeps its persisted rows.

match: token-metrics: price read failed, degrading
reason: A token price read failing; the metric degrades to null, never a fabricated price.

match: \(swarm\.judge\) failed, retry in <n>s: judge produced no judgement \(model_timeout
reason: One judge attempt timed out at the model provider and the job is retrying; a judge job that exhausts its retries logs '— DEAD', which stays fatal. An outcome of the model, not a platform failure (owner, 2026-09-25).

match: member-session-client failed: model take's
reason: A member's model returned a take that failed validation (e.g. a WEIGHTS clause missing a canonical bucket); by design the member is rendered absent, never defaulted, and attendance is graded separately. An outcome of the model, not a platform failure (owner, 2026-09-25).

match: member-session-client failed: opencode inference timed out after <n>ms
reason: The member's model provider did not answer in time; the member is rendered absent, never given a template take. An outcome of the model, not a platform failure (owner, 2026-09-25).

match: Found orphan containers \(\S*member-agent
reason: Compose notices the per-session member-agent containers it did not define; they are the driver's own and it removes them.

match: session container exited <n> without a verified submission
reason: The driver's summary line for any failed member; the cause is logged on its own line and classified there (402, a closed window, a rejected take).

match: cannot execute (UPDATE|INSERT|DELETE|SELECT FOR UPDATE) in a read-only transaction|a DELETE was refused, but NOT by the guard .* read-only transaction
reason: The managed cluster switches to read-only as its disk fills with analytics-ledger rows (8.2 GB on 2026-09-25).

match: No space left on device|could not (extend|write to) file
reason: The managed cluster's disk is full (analytics-ledger growth).

match: CONNECTION_CLOSED|CONNECT_TIMEOUT|terminating connection due to administrator command|database unavailable|connect ECONNREFUSED [0-9.]+:25060
reason: Connections dropped while the managed cluster protected itself from a full disk; also the managed cluster refusing connections (port 25060) while it restarts, e.g. the storage upsize on 2026-09-25 17:43.

match: cause=(quota-limited|exhausted-credits)|Insufficient balance
reason: The OpenCode Zen account behind a member or judge key was out of credit (HTTP 402 quota-limited, production 2026-09-24 23:08 and 2026-09-25 05:19). Operational, not code: after the release the judge uses the same key, so a recurrence fails the post-release gate until the account is funded.

match: REFUSING the boot: the append-only guard is NOT armed
reason: The guard misread a read-only session as a disarmed guard and refused boots; fixed in v0.5.1 (25006 is inconclusive).

match: POST /api/analytics/(source-acquisitions|telemetry|vintages) failed: HTTP <n>
reason: The api's analytics writes fail while the cluster is read-only or full; the api's own PostgresError is classified separately.

match: upstream prematurely closed connection|connect\(\) failed \(<n>: Connection refused\) while connecting to upstream
reason: nginx losing the api during database stalls and refused boots; follows from the database state.

match: \[window\] session read failed \(attempt <n>\): GET /api/swarm/sessions/\S+ -> HTTP (502|503|504); retrying|\[window\] session read failed \(attempt \d+\): GET /api/swarm/sessions/\S+ -> HTTP (502|503|504); retrying
reason: The host driver re-reading its open session while the api is saturated by analytics-ledger writes (production 2026-09-26 00:00 and 00:30-00:39); it retries without limit inside the window wait and never aborts the session. A symptom of the api outages issue 1035 causes.

match: ops\.repair_gaps\) failed
reason: The gap-repair job fails on dropped database connections.

match: model_unconfigured
reason: The judge had no model; migration 0063 sets the CI model in v0.5.1.

match: permission denied for table (wallet_backfill_state|chain_day_blocks|chain_address_floors)
reason: rm_worker lacked the wallet-backfill grants; migration 0061 grants them in v0.5.1.

match: \\u<n> cannot be converted to text|unsupported Unicode escape sequence
reason: Parity evidence carried a NUL into jsonb; fixed in v0.5.1 (61ee2a0d).

match: \[analytics-producer\] (indicator catch-up|regime failed): .*The socket connection was closed unexpectedly
reason: The analytics producer's first call to the api after a long idle gap fails on a closed kept-alive socket (production 2026-09-25 21:30 and 21:31, 29 min after its previous call; the api logged nothing and did not restart). The producer skips that pass and retries on its next schedule.
tolerateAfterRelease: Pre-existing in v0.5.0 and untouched by v0.5.1; tolerated at the cutover (triage 2026-09-25 21:35), to be fixed in a later release.

match: parity_sweep\) failed.*socket connection was closed|\[Bun\.serve\]: request timed out
reason: The parity sweep outlived the api's ~10 s idle timeout; v0.5.1 lifts it for that request. (Log-line form.)

match: socket connection was closed unexpectedly
reason: The same sweep timeout, as the dead job's own last_error (prod:gate grades dead jobs by their stored error).
